name: Joshua Tan
oneLineBio: Leads product and strategy for Public AI.
bio: Joshua Tan leads product and strategy for the Public AI movement, building AI as public infrastructure. He is also a co-founder and research director at Metagov, a research lab focused on digital governance and institution design.

name: Fletcher Kittredge
oneLineBio: Founder of GWI, Maine's B Corp internet provider.
bio: Fletcher Kittredge founded and led GWI (Great Works Internet) in Biddeford for three decades, building it into Maine's first B Corp-certified telecom carrier. He also chairs the ConnectME Authority Advisory Board and serves on the board of the Maine Center for Public Interest Reporting.

name: Matthew Victor
oneLineBio: Technology transactions attorney at Bernstein Shur.
bio: Matthew Victor is an associate at Bernstein Shur who counsels startups and early-stage companies on technology licensing, corporate transactions, and data privacy. He previously worked as a technology consultant and co-founded a nonprofit before practicing law.

name: Richard Qualey
oneLineBio: Energy and environmental law attorney at Bernstein Shur.
bio: Richard Qualey is an energy and environmental attorney at Bernstein Shur who pairs a chemical engineering background with legal counsel on land use, environmental compliance, and regulatory matters. He previously clerked for the Maine Supreme Judicial Court.

name: Ben Polsky
oneLineBio: Data center and broadband infrastructure strategist.
bio: Ben Polsky is Director of Partnership and Business Development at Vivacity Infrastructure Group, focused on data center and utility partnerships. He previously managed California's $3.87 billion open-access middle-mile broadband program and is an International Strategy Fellow at the Special Competitive Studies Project.

name: Tom Law
oneLineBio: Founder and CEO of Oak AI, a Maine-based applied-AI startup.
bio: Tom Law founded Oak AI in Portland to build AI tools that give people more agency and privacy online. He previously spent over a decade in engineering leadership roles across wireless, energy, and robotics.

name: Kerem Durdag
oneLineBio: President & COO of Great Works Internet (GWI).
bio: Kerem Durdag is President and COO of GWI, Maine's B Corp-certified internet provider, where he has led rural broadband buildouts across the state. He also helped launch the Indus Fund, providing below-market loans to Maine's immigrant business community.

name: Sam Merkatz
oneLineBio: Studying government and science, technology & society at Colby College.
bio: Sam Merkatz is a Colby College student studying government and science, technology, and society, with a focus on tech policy and regulation. He previously interned as a Virtual Student Federal Service fellow at the U.S. Department of State and won Colby's 2025 Government Department Prize.
